meta.note: Deep-sky objects: the Messier and Caldwell lists plus well-known extras. Positions, sizes and magnitudes from OpenNGC (CC BY-SA 4.0) and Barnard 1927 (VizieR VII/220A); every distance from its cited source (dr, a key into refs; dq: m measured for the object, its cluster or its illuminating star; a from the complex it belongs to; r rough). a, b: major and minor axis (arcmin); pa: position angle (deg E of N); rpc: the major semi-axis in pc; v: V (or B) magnitude; age: log10 age (yr); nmem: Gaia members (Hunt & Reffert 2023); far: a galaxy beyond the Local Group (not drawn); lg/rad: a link to a localgroup.json galaxy / radio.json source; part: drawn as part of another object.
